visual_overrides.core_identity: An apparently decorative floor rug animated into a flexible constricting sheet that wraps a victim with no face or limbs.
visual_overrides.silhouette: Large rectangular textile lifting in a curling wave while corners and edges fold around a central target.
visual_overrides.head_features: No head, eyes, or mouth; menace comes entirely from folding and wrapping motion.
visual_overrides.body_shape: Flat woven rectangle capable of bending, rolling, and wrapping while retaining identifiable rug edges.
visual_overrides.surface: Broad simple geometric or heraldic pattern with large colorable areas and sparse fringe.

scene_overrides.natural_posture: The textile remains visibly connected to floor, victim, or surrounding surfaces through folds and contact rather than floating freely.
behavior_style: curling upward from an apparently normal floor position
